# 技术简介  

## 仪器平台    

&emsp;&emsp;PhenoCycler-Fusion 单细胞原位空间组学分析平台作为快速高效的空间生物学解决方案，通过集成自动化液流和循环成像，实现全片单细胞分辨率下的超高参数空间表型分析。    

**超高参数**： 每张组织切片可同时检测 100种以上蛋白标志物    
**高精度**： 实现真正单细胞水平像素， 最高可达 0.25 um /像素     
**客观**： 对整张组织切片上的每个细胞进行无偏差的空间表型分析    


## 适用样本及样本要求   


**样本类型**： 石蜡切片（FFPE）、 冰冻切片（FF）、 组织芯片（TMA）等     
**样本尺寸**： 建议组织切片厚度为石蜡切片4-5um、冰冻切片8-10um， 面积不超过 18 x 35mm      



# 实验流程

## 实验原理    

&emsp;&emsp;基于独特的 PhenoCycler 超多重免疫荧光染色技术的组织空间蛋白组探索服务计划(STEP)， 在 PhenoCycler-Fusion平台上进行单细胞原位空间组学检测服务。 在检测中使用的每种抗体上都标记有特异性寡核苷酸“条形码标签”(Barcode)。 成像所需的荧光染料上标记和抗体 Barcode 互补的特异性寡核苷酸序列。 通过“染色-成像-移除荧光” 自动化循环， 在PhenoCycler-Fusion 平台上实现多达 100 种以上的蛋白指标的同时检测及分析， 突破传统成像通道数量的限制。

## 实验步骤    

### 样本预处理  
 
1)&emsp;FFPE 样本通过 PCF 标准 S0P 进行脱蜡和水化处理；    
2)&emsp;按照 PCF 标准的抗原修复法， 酸或碱修复， 采用免疫组化压力锅进行修复；    
3)&emsp;室温避光封闭和抗体染色；   
4)&emsp;组织固定（冰甲醇＋1.6%多聚甲醛＋PCF 固定剂）；      
5)&emsp;核染色通过 PCF 标准的 DAPI 染色完成， 待上机检测。   
 

### 组织识别 
 
5)&emsp;根据明场捕获图像显示的组织形状，通过PCF的组织识别灵敏度来尽可能识别到所有组织区域，以完成最终的荧光定量图片数据的获取。         
 

### 背景自发荧光成像

6)&emsp;通过20×物镜检测背景自发荧光，后续扣除。     
  
 
### 多轮染色

7)&emsp;染色：每轮过程使用DAPI及另外最多3个抗体对组织样本进行染色；         
8)&emsp;成像：对标记的biomarker进行成像；         
9)&emsp;解离：使用解离液将本轮染色的荧光发色基团解离并洗去；      
10)&emsp;重复步骤7-步骤9，直到完成panel中所有的蛋白的成像。    


### 图像处理 
 
11)&emsp;独特的自动化图像采集后处理，提供完美拼接和精确校准的图像数据，通过HALO数字病理图像分析平台 实现真正意义上的单细胞超多重蛋白免疫荧光分析。         


### 目标圈选和数据分析 
 
12)&emsp;通过精准的兴趣区域（ROI）来提取目标信息，确定特定蛋白质的丰度及定位，从而对整体空间位置进行定性和定量分析。

```{r cell_type}
celltypes <-

# cell_type中指定的细胞有些重叠的

# 因此根据精细程度的分级，分为互斥的三个等级

# 除了Classification2里面的Others T需要通过手动计算来添加
cell_annotation <-
  readxl::read_excel("../data/cell_types.xlsx", sheet = 2) %>%
  map(~ .x[!is.na(.x)])
```

## 数据分析结果  
 

```{r load_analysis_data, include=FALSE}
# 计算所有ROI的各细胞类型的阴阳性比例
positive_df <- cd_final %>% panelPostiveStat_speed(panel = celltypes) 
positive_table_df <- 
  cd_final %>%
  panelPostiveStat_speed(panel = celltypes, result = "cell_table") 

# some ROI not found in meta_roi
# 其实在最开始的时候就应该将这些不需要的ROI或者Cell从cd_final中删除
# 由于没有写好CellDive类的`[`方法，因此在这里将数据进行去除
stopifnot(
  length(meta_roi_uniq$SegmentDisplayName %>% .[! . %in% names(positive_df)]) < 1
)

positive_df_tidy <-
  positive_df %>%
  rownames_to_column("CellType") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -CellType,
    names_to = "SegmentDisplayName",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_roi_uniq[, c("ID", "SegmentDisplayName")], by = 'SegmentDisplayName') %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-SegmentDisplayName)

```



### 细胞比例饼图{.tabshow}   
&nbsp;
&emsp;&emsp;使用HALO数字病理图像分析平台对PCF的产出结果进行分析，获得每个细胞的各Marker的表达量及Marker的阴阳性cutoff值。   
&emsp;&emsp;根据每种细胞的Marker定义，计算每个ROI/AOI中的各细胞类型的比例。此细胞比例类似于常规生信分析中的Normlize处理，其值可以用于多个ROI/AOI之间的比较。   



```{r pie, echo = F, out.width="80%", results='asis',  fig.width = 10, fig.height=15}

walk(User_columns, function(column){
  cat(paste0("\n\n#### ", column, "  {.unnumbered}  \n\n"))
  dat <- 
    positive_df_tidy %>%
    left_join(meta_roi_uniq[, c(column, "ID"), drop=FALSE]) %>%
    # mutate(CellType = ifelse( # 将Adjacent Tumor设置为Epithelials ----------------------------
    #   test = .data[[column]] != "Adjacent", 
    #   yes  = CellType, 
    #   no   = CellType %>% str_replace_all("Tumor cell", "Epithelials"))
    # ) %>%
    group_by(.data[[column]], CellType) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(value)) %>%
    group_by(.data[[column]]) %>%
    mutate(value = value/sum(value))
  
  p <- dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = value, fill = CellType)) +
      geom_col() +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
  
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()
      ) +
      ggsci::scale_fill_igv()+
      facet_wrap(~ .data[[column]]) +
      coord_polar(theta = "y")
  
  print(p)
  cat("  \n\n")
})

```
  

<!-- 双分组细胞比例饼图 -->
```{r, pie2, echo = F, out.width="80%", results='asis',  fig.width = 10, fig.height=15}

# 有双分组需求才进行双分组分析
eval_for <- FALSE
if(!is.null(Group_data) && 
   all(dim(Group_data) > 0)){
      eval_for <- TRUE
}

if(eval_for){
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("### 双分组细胞比例饼图{.tabshow}  \n\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("&emsp;&emsp;根据两个变量来分组统计细胞比例的分布饼图。    ")
  
  cat("\n\n")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(Group_data)){
    # 多组比较的组别
    r <- Group_data[i, ] %>% unlist
    r <- r[!is.na(r)]
    grp <- names(r)
    grp <- sort(grp)
    
    if(length(grp) != 2){
      stop("双分组分析只应该包含两个变量")
    }
    
    # 正向
    p1 <-
      positive_df_tidy %>%
      left_join(meta_roi_uniq[, c(grp, "ID"), drop=FALSE]) %>%
      # mutate(CellType = ifelse(# 将Adjacent Tumor设置为Epithelials ----------------------------
      #   HRD_Group != "Adjacent", 
      #   CellType, 
      #   CellType %>% str_replace_all("Tumor cell", "Epithelials")
      # )) %>%
      group_by(CellType, .data[[grp[1]]], .data[[grp[2]]]) %>%
      summarise(value = mean(value)) %>%
      group_by(.data[[grp[1]]], .data[[grp[2]]]) %>%
      mutate(value = value/sum(value)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = value, fill = CellType)) +
      geom_col() +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
    
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()
      ) +
      ggsci::scale_fill_igv()+
      facet_grid(rlang::inject(!!sym(grp[1]) ~ !!sym(grp[2]))) +
      # facet_grid(grp[1] ~ grp[2]) +
      coord_polar(theta = "y")
    
    # print
    cat(paste0("\n\n#### ", grp[1], " X ", grp[2], " {.unnumbered} \n\n"))
    print(p1)
    cat("\n\n")
```

### 细胞比例小提琴图{.tabshow}    
&nbsp;
&emsp;&emsp;对每个分组中的各个细胞类型的细胞比例数据绘制小提琴图。    


```{r volin, echo = F, out.width="80%", results='asis', fig.width = 20, fig.height=25}

walk(User_columns, function(column){
  cat(paste0("\n\n#### ", column,  "  {.unnumbered}  \n\n"))
  dat <- 
    positive_df_tidy %>%
    left_join(meta_roi_uniq[, c(column, "ID"), drop=FALSE]) 
    
  # browser()
  
  levs <- dat[[column]] %>% unique 
  if(length(levs) <= 4){
    geom_de <- 
      ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = levs %>% combn(2) %>% apply(2, c, simplify = FALSE),
        label = "p.signif",
        label.y.npc = 1.1
      )
  }else{
    geom_de <- theme()
  }
  
  p <- dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[column]], y = value, fill = .data[[column]])) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, color = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3)+
    geom_de +
    facet_wrap(~CellType, scales = "free") +
    # theme_bw() +
    ggpubr::theme_pubclean() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = function(x) c(x[1], 1.4 * x[2])) +
    ggsci::scale_fill_aaas() +
    labs(
      y = "Cell Proportion"
    )
  
  
  
  print(p)
  cat("  \n\n")
})
```

```{r, volin2, echo = F, out.width="80%", results='asis',  fig.width = 20, fig.height=25}
              label = "p.signif",

            )
        }else{
```

### 细胞类型相关性热图{.tabshow}  

&nbsp;
&emsp;&emsp;绘制细胞类型之间的相关性热图，红色底色位正相关性，蓝色底色为负相关性，如果相关性大于0.5或者小于-0.5则绘制一个和底色相对应的点图。    

```{r cell_corr, echo = F, out.width="80%", results='asis', fig.width = 10, fig.height=15}

walk(User_columns, function(column){
  cat(paste0("\n\n#### ", column, "{.tabshow .unnumbered} \n\n"))
  
  p_ls <-
    positive_df_tidy %>%
    left_join(meta_roi_uniq[, c(column, "ID"), drop=FALSE]) %>%
    group_by(.data[[column]]) %>%
    nest %>%
    deframe() %>%
    imap(function(x, name){# browser()
  
  
      all_cells <- x$CellType %>% unique
  
      # dat
      xx <-
        x %>%
        pivot_wider(
          names_from = "CellType",
          values_from = "value"
        ) %>%
        # dplyr::select(!any_of(c("ID", "Segment_ID")))
        dplyr::select(all_of(all_cells))
  
      # hclust
      cor_dat <- cor(xx)
  
      cor_dat[is.na(cor_dat)] <- 0 # NA值设置为0
  
      hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_dat))
      order_cell <- hc$labels[hc$order]
  
      # full data; plot background
      dat <- cor_dat %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("row") %>%
        pivot_longer(
          -row,
          names_to = "col",
          values_to = "value"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          row = factor(row, levels = order_cell),
          col = factor(col, levels = order_cell)
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          row_num = as.numeric(row),
          col_num = as.numeric(col)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          row_num < col_num
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(col = fct_rev(col)) %>%
        mutate(group = ifelse(value > 0, "P", "N"))
  
      p <-
        dat %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = col, y = row)) +
        geom_tile(aes(fill = group), color = 'gray', show.legend = FALSE) +
        coord_fixed() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(P = "#FEF6F6", N = "#E6ECF6")) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(),
          axis.title = element_blank()
        ) +
        labs(title = name)
      
      # negative
      dat_neg <- dat %>%
        dplyr::filter(value <= -0.5) %>%
        mutate(Negative = ifelse(value <= -0.75, "-0.75 to -1.0", "-0.5 to -0.75")) %>%
        mutate(Negative = factor(Negative, levels = c("-0.5 to -0.75", "-0.75 to -1.0")))
  
  
      p1 <- p +
        geom_point(
          data = dat_neg,
          aes(x = col, y = row, color = Negative),
          size = 6
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c("#B0C3E3", "#023fa5") # RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[c(4, 6)]
        )
  
      # postive
      dat_pos <- dat %>%
        dplyr::filter(value >= 0.5) %>%
        mutate(Positive = ifelse(value >= 0.75, "0.75 to 1.0", "0.5 to 0.75")) %>%
        mutate(Positive = factor(Positive, levels = c("0.75 to 1.0", "0.5 to 0.75")))
  
      p2 <- p1 +
        ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
        geom_point(
          data = dat_pos,
          aes(x = col, y = row, color = Positive),
          size = 6
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c("#ef1a22", "#FAB7BA") # RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Reds")[c(6, 4)]
        ) +
        guides(
          color = guide_legend(order = 1, ),
          new_aes = guide_legend(order = 2)
        )
  
      p2
    })
    
  # print
  
  p_ls %>%
    iwalk(~{
      cat(paste0("\n\n##### ", .y, " {.unnumbered} \n\n"))
      print(.x)
      cat("\n\n")
    })
  
  cat("\n\n")
})

```

### channel相关性热图{.tabshow}  

&nbsp;
&emsp;&emsp;绘制各个Marker（channel）之间的相关性热图。    



```{r marker_corr, echo = F, out.width="80%",  results='asis', fig.width = 10, fig.height=10}

walk(User_columns, function(column){
  cat(paste0("\n\n#### ", column, " {.tabshow .unnumbered}  \n\n"))
  
  p_ls <-
    meta_roi %>%
    group_by(.data[[column]]) %>%
    nest() %>%
    deframe() %>%
    map('obj_id') %>%
    imap(function(x, name){#  browser()
      xx <- x %>% make.names()
      dat <- cd_final[, xx] %>% GetAssayData() %>% as.matrix() %>% t %>% cor()
      # colnames(dat) <- rownames(dat) <- colnames(dat) %>% str_remove("-.*$")
      
      # dat_notNA <- dat
      # dat_notNA[is.na(dat_notNA)] <- 0
      
      val_rng <- range(dat, na.rm = TRUE)
      if(val_rng[1] * val_rng[2] < 0){
        bk1 <- seq(val_rng[1], 0, by = 0.01)
        bk2 <- seq(0.01, val_rng[2], by = 0.01)
        
        col_val <- c(
          colorRampPalette(c("#3398CB", "white"))(length(bk1)),
          colorRampPalette(c("white", "#ef4d5d"))(length(bk2))
        )
      }else{
        col_val <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#ef4d5d"))(50)
      }
      
      # corrplot::corrplot(dat, order = "hclust")
      hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - dat), method = "ward.D2")
  
      p <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
        dat,
        color = col_val,
        border_color = NA,
        scale = "none",
        cluster_rows = hc,
        cluster_cols = hc,
        main = name,
        silent = TRUE
      )
      p$gtable %>% ggpubr::as_ggplot()
  })
  
  # print
  p_ls %>%
    iwalk(function(p, name){
      cat(paste0("\n\n##### ", name, " {.unnumbered} \n\n"))
      print(p)
      cat("\n\n")
    })
  
  cat("\n\n")
})
```

&nbsp;
&emsp;&emsp;使用Seurat对HALO分析的单细胞蛋白表达矩阵进行降维、聚类分析。      



```{r, include=FALSE}

assign('more', 0, envir = warnning_env)
assign("less", 0, envir = warnning_env)
```



```{r sc, echo = F, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}

sc <-
  cd_final %>%
  .[! rownames(.) %in% "DAPI", ] %>% # remove DAPI
  # as("Seurat") %>%
  celldive2Seurat() %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA()

# 内存回收
if(params$gc){
  # rm(cd_final)
  gc()
}

# only use ROI in annotation table
sc_meta <- sc[['ID']] %>%
  dplyr::rename(SegmentDisplayName = ID) %>%
  rownames_to_column("row_name") %>%
  right_join(
    meta_roi_uniq[, c(User_columns, 'ID', 'SegmentDisplayName')],
    by = 'SegmentDisplayName',
    suffix = c("", "_anno")
  )

stopifnot(all(!duplicated(sc_meta$row_name))) # 没有重复的cell_id, 则根据WTA中的ROI取出CellDive的数据，否则报错
sc_filter <- sc[, sc_meta$row_name]

stopifnot(all(sc_meta$row_name == colnames(sc_filter))) # 顺序一致，则addMetaData
sc_filter <- sc_filter %>% AddMetaData(column_to_rownames(sc_meta, "row_name"))


# ElbowPlot(sc_filter, ndims = 15) # only have 15 channels
if(run_harmony){
  sc_filter <- sc_filter %>%
    harmony::RunHarmony(
      group.by.vars = harmony_group,
      assay.use = "protein"
    )
  
  sc2 <- sc_filter %>% 
    RunTSNE(
      dims = 1:(nrow(sc_filter)-1), 
      check_duplicates = FALSE,
      num_threads = 0,
      reduction = "harmony"
    )
  
  
  plan("multisession", workers = 4, gc = TRUE)
  sc2 <- sc2 %>% 
    RunUMAP(
      dims = 1:(nrow(sc2)-1),
    	min.dist = 0.1,
    	spread = 1.5,
    	n.neighbors = 50,
    	local.connectivity = 3,
      reduction = "harmony"
    )
  plan("sequential")
  future:::ClusterRegistry("stop")
  
  #saveRDS(sc2, "../sc2.rds")

}else{
  # run umap
  sc2 <- sc_filter %>% 
    RunTSNE(
      dims = 1:(nrow(sc_filter)-1), 
      check_duplicates = FALSE,
      num_threads = 0
    )
  
  # run umap
  plan("multisession", workers = 4, gc = TRUE)
  sc2 <- sc2 %>% 
    RunUMAP(
      dims      = 1:(nrow(sc2)-1),
    	min.dist  = 0.1,
    	spread    = 1.5,
    	n.neighbors = 50,
    	local.connectivity = 3
    )
  
  plan("sequential")
  future:::ClusterRegistry("stop")
  
  # saveRDS(sc2, "sc2.rds")
}
```

```{r sc2, echo = F}
# annotation_df <- cd_final %>%

cell_annotation_df <-
  cell_annotation %>%
  map(function(cell_combn){

    positive_table_df %>%
    map(., cell = rownames(.), cell_types = cell_combn,
        function(x, cell, cell_types){ # browser()
          if(all(!x)) return("Others")
          xx <- cell[x] # all positive cells

          idx <- xx %in% cell_combn
          if(sum(idx) > 1) {
            assign('more', get('more', envir = warnning_env) + 1, envir = warnning_env)
            # return(str_c(xx[idx], collapse = " - "))
            return("Multi")
          }
          if(sum(idx) < 1) {
            assign('less', get('less', envir = warnning_env) + 1, envir = warnning_env)

            # if(length(xx) == 1) return(xx)
            # 
            # stopifnot(length(xx) > 1)
            # return("Multi") # 这种情况的细胞注释一定是大于1
            
            return("Others") 
          }
          return(xx[idx])
    })
  })

cell_annotation_df_tidy <-
  cell_annotation_df %>%
  imap(~ enframe(.x, name = "ID", value = .y)) %>%
  map(~ mutate(.x, across(where(is.list), unlist))) %>%
  map(column_to_rownames, var = "ID") %>%
  do.call(cbind, .)

# 如果一个细胞没有分配为任一种细胞类型，则去除此细胞
# 考虑到CellDive仅有10+个marker，并不一定能够覆盖到ROI中的所有细胞类型

any_true <- positive_table_df %>% map(~ any(.)) %>%　.[unlist(.)] %>% names() # 至少有一个CellType注释的细胞

  sc2 %>%
  AddMetaData(cell_annotation_df_tidy)

sc_anno2 <- sc_anno[, any_true] # only use cells have cell_type
```

### 细胞社区分析  

```{r cn, include=FALSE}
k.nn      <- 50 # 多少个最近邻细胞
k.cluster <- 10 # 多少个CN cluster


cn_nn_cellfreq_ls <- 
  # c('Classification1', 'Classification2', 'Classification3') %>%
  cell_annotation %>%
  names() %>%
  set_names(., .) %>%
  map(function(x){
    all_celltypes <- sc_anno2[[x]] %>% unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>% unique() %>% as.character()
    
    # construct NN per slide
    cn_nn_cellfreq_ls <-
      sc_anno2[[]] %>% 
      rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% 
      mutate(X = (XMin + XMax)/2, Y = (YMin + YMax)/2) %>% 
      dplyr::select(
        X, 
        Y, 
        .data[[cn_group]],
        cell_id, 
        celltype = x 
      ) %>% 
      group_by(.data[[cn_group]]) %>%
      nest() %>%
      deframe() %>%
      
      purrr::discard(function(x) nrow(x) < k.nn) %>% # 数据行小于k.nn无法进行NN计算
      
      imap(function(dat, name){ # browser()
    
        cn_nn <- RANN::nn2(dat[c('X', 'Y')], k = k.nn)
        cn_nn_index2cell <- as.character(dat$celltype)[cn_nn$nn.idx]
        
        dim(cn_nn_index2cell)      <- dim(cn_nn$nn.idx)
        rownames(cn_nn_index2cell) <- dat$cell_id
        
        # get cell frequency table
        # add all celltypes, make sure all cell exist in every neighborhood
        cn_all_celltypes <- matrix(
          all_celltypes, 
          nrow = nrow(cn_nn_index2cell), 
          ncol = length(all_celltypes), 
          byrow = TRUE
        )
        cn_nn_cell2 <- cbind(cn_nn_index2cell, cn_all_celltypes)
        
        # all cell have been added 1, so minus 1
        # table will sort the celltype, so all celltype have identical order 
        cn_nn_cellcount <- apply(cn_nn_cell2, 1, table) - 1 
        cn_nn_cellfreq  <- sweep(cn_nn_cellcount, 2, FUN = "/", colSums(cn_nn_cellcount))
        
        cn_nn_cellfreq
      })
    
    # cn_nn_cellfreq
    # row: CellType; column: cell_id
    cn_nn_cellfreq <- do.call(cbind, cn_nn_cellfreq_ls)
    
    cn_nn_cellfreq
  })


# construct CN by all slide

# cn_cluster_ls <- map(2:20, ~ kmeans(t(cn_nn_cellfreq), centers = .x, iter.max = 1000))
# cn_cluster_vrc <- map(cn_cluster_ls, ~ fpc::calinhara(t(cn_nn_cellfreq), .x$cluster)) # compute 方差比

# plot(
#   x = 2:20, 
#   y = unlist(cn_cluster_vrc), 
#   ylab = "Calinski-Harabasz index", 
#   xlab = "Number of Clusters"
# )

# cluster_number <- 6

cn_meta_data_ls <-
  cn_nn_cellfreq_ls %>%
  map(function(cn_nn_cellfreq){
    set.seed(1234)
    cn_cluster   <- kmeans(t(cn_nn_cellfreq), centers = k.cluster, iter.max = 1000)
    cn_meta_data <- 
      cn_cluster$cluster %>% 
      enframe("cell_id", "CN") %>% 
      column_to_rownames("cell_id") %>%
      mutate(CN = str_c("CN", CN)) %>%
      mutate(CN = factor(CN, levels = str_c("CN", sort(unique(cn_cluster$cluster)))))
    
    list(
      cn_cluster   = cn_cluster, 
      cn_meta_data = cn_meta_data
    )
  })


# sc_anno2_cn <-
#   sc_anno2 %>%
#   AddMetaData(cn_meta_data)

```


```{r cn_heat, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}

p_cn_heat_ls <-
  cn_meta_data_ls %>%
  imap(function(x, name){
    cn_cluster <- x$cn_cluster
    cn_nn_cellfreq <- cn_nn_cellfreq_ls[[name]]
    
    # FoldChange cluster/allCell
    cn_cluster_mean <- cn_cluster$centers
    cn_baseMean     <- rowMeans(cn_nn_cellfreq)
    
    # log2(FC)
    cn_cluster_FC <- log2(1 + sweep(cn_cluster_mean, MARGIN = 2, FUN = "/", STATS = cn_baseMean))
    
    # heatmap
    p_cn_heat <-
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        cn_cluster_FC,
        color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
        border_color = NA,
        treeheight_row = 0,
        labels_row = str_c("CN", rownames(cn_cluster_FC), sep = "_"),
        cluster_rows = T,
        scale = "column",
        silent = TRUE
      )
    p_cn_heat
  })


# export
cat("#### CellNeighborhood CN celltype heatmap  {.unnumbered .tabshow} \n\n")

p_cn_heat_ls %>%
  iwalk(function(p, name){
    cat(paste0("##### ", name, " {.unnumbered} \n\n"))
    
    grid::grid.newpage()
    print(p)
    
    cat("\n\n")
  })

cat("\n\n")
```

<!-- css for tabshow and tabset-diy -->
```{css, echo=FALSE}
/*tab show*/
select{
    padding: 5px;
    padding-right: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    margin-right: 5%;
/*    float: left; */
}
select:hover{
    box-shadow: 0px 0px 2px 2px #AAB2D1;
    cursor: pointer;
}
p::before{ /*清除浮动的影响*/
    content: "";
    display: block;
    clear: both;
}

.tabclear::after{
    content: '';
    display: block;
    clear: both;
}

/*tabset diy*/
.tab-ul{
    margin: 0px;
    padding: 0px;
    padding-top:10px;
}

.tab-ul::before, .tab-ul::after{
    content: '';
    clear: both;
    display: block;
}

.tab-li{
    padding: 4px 20px;
    margin-right: 3px;
    list-style: none;
    background: #eee;
    cursor: pointer;
    float: left;
    transition: background 0.5s;
}
.tab-li.active{
    border-top: 3px solid #8d95aa;
    border-left: 1px solid #8d95aa;
    border-right: 1px solid #8d95aa;
    background: white;
    padding: 6px 20px;
    margin-bottom: -1px;
}

.tab-li:hover{
    background: #bbc1da;
}

.tabset-diy .section{
    border: 1px solid #8d95aa;
}
```

<!-- 折叠布局，tabshow控制 兼容ie-->
```{js, echo = FALSE}
$(function(){

  // 所有需要折叠子元素的div，class有tabshow
  var tabs = $('.tabshow');
  
  for(var i =0; i < tabs.length; i++){
    var tablist,  // 需要折叠的子元素div
        id_list,  // 折叠div的id
        text_list; // 折叠div的text，用于select的option中显示
    
    tablist = tabs.eq(i).children('.section');
    if(tablist.length < 2) {continue;}
    
    id_list = tablist.map(function(){ return '#' + $(this).attr('id') }).get();
    text_list = tablist.map(function(){ return $(this).children(':not("div")').eq(0).hide().text() });
    text_list = text_list.map(function(){ return this.replace(/^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*\s{1}/g, '') }).get();
    
    // 构造select元素
    var select = $('<select>').attr('id', 'tab-select' + i);
    for(var j=0; j < id_list.length; j++){
      var op = $('<option>').attr('value', id_list[j]).text(text_list[j]);
      if(j === 0){
        op = op.attr('selected', 'selected');
      }
      select.append(op);
    }
    
    // select使用一个div包裹
    select = $('<div>').append(select);
    // 如果有clear类属性，则将select的父div加上clear属性
    var className = tablist.eq(0).attr('class');
    if(/clear/.test(className)){
      select.addClass('tabclear')
    }
    // 将select嵌入DOM中
    tablist.eq(0).before(select);
    
    // 初始化，默认显示第一个子元素div，其他隐藏
    $(id_list[0]).show().siblings('.section').hide();
    
    // 绑定select的change事件，动态改变div的显隐
    $('#'+'tab-select' + i).change(function(){
      var val = $(this).val();
      $(val).show().siblings('.section').hide();
    })
  }

})


```

<!-- 自定义tabset（默认tabset无法作用于h6之后的标题） 兼容ie-->
```{js, echo = FALSE}
$(function(){

  // 所有需要折叠子元素的div，class有tabset-diy
  var tabs = $('.tabset-diy');
  
  for(var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++){
    var tablist,  // 需要折叠的子元素div
        id_list,  // 折叠div的id
        text_list; // 折叠div的text，用于select的option中显示
    
    tablist = tabs.eq(i).children('.section');
    if(tablist.length < 2) {continue;}
    
    id_list = tablist.map(function() { return '#' + $(this).attr('id') }).get();
    text_list = tablist.map(function(){ return $(this).children().eq(0).hide().text(); });
    text_list = text_list.map(function(){ return this.replace(/^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*\s{1}/g, '') }).get();
    
    // 构造ul元素
    var ul = $('<ul>').attr('id', 'tab-ul' + i).addClass('tab-ul');
    for(var j=0; j < id_list.length; j++){
      var li = $('<li>').addClass('tab-li')
                        .attr('data-item', id_list[j])
                        .text(text_list[j]);
      if(j === 0){
        li = li.addClass('active');
      }
      ul.append(li);
    }
    
    // 将select嵌入DOM中
    tablist.eq(0).before(ul);
    
    // 初始化，默认显示第一个子元素div，其他隐藏
    $(id_list[0]).show().siblings('.section').hide();
    
    // 绑定ul的li的click事件，动态改变div的显隐
    $('#'+'tab-ul' + i + ' > li').click(function(){
      // li的active class改变
      $(this).addClass('active').siblings().removeClass('active')
      // li对应的div的显隐
      var item = $(this).attr('data-item');
      $(item).show().siblings('.section').hide();
    })
  }

})


```
